settings.heading: What are you storing?
settings.description: Find the kind of thing you plan to store and see which range suits it best.
settings.note: Weights are approximate guides only. Add up what you plan to place on each shelf and keep it comfortably under the rated load for that shelf.

settings.heading: Weigh what you are storing
settings.text: List your heaviest items and estimate the total weight on each shelf. Under 150kg per shelf, MDF will do the job. Above that - or if the load will be tough on the shelf - choose steel, which is rated to 200kg per shelf.

settings.heading: Measure your space
settings.text: Measure the height, width and depth of the spot. Our steel racks are 600mm deep, while MDF racks range from 300-450mm deep, which suits tighter spaces. Leave room to reach every shelf.

settings.heading: Plan how it gets home
settings.text: Every unit arrives flat-packed in boxes. Check our How To Collect In Your Vehicle guide to see if it will fit in your car, or have it delivered.

settings.heading: Pick your size and quantity
settings.text: Match the unit to your space and load, then add more units side by side if you need more storage - our steel racks are designed to be expandable.

settings.heading: How to choose in four steps
settings.description: A simple way to match the right unit to your space and your load.
settings.help_text: Tell us what you are storing and where it is going, and we will recommend the right unit for you.

settings.question: Can I store heavy items on MDF shelving?
settings.answer: Each MDF layer is rated to 150kg (750kg per unit). If you will be loading more than that on a single shelf, or storing very heavy items such as machinery parts or full paint tins, choose steel shelving, which is rated to 200kg per shelf.

settings.question: Can I add more units later?
settings.answer: Our steel shelving racks are designed to be expandable, so you can add more units side by side as your storage needs grow. If you are planning a long run of shelving, contact us and we will help you work out what you need.

settings.question: Can I fix the shelving to the floor?
settings.answer: Our steel shelving can be used free-standing or securely fixed to the ground. For tall units holding heavy loads, fixing them down adds extra stability.

settings.question: Can MDF shelving be used as a workbench?
settings.answer: Our MDF shelving listings note that it can be converted into a workbench, which suits lighter projects. For heavier work, a steel workbench (rated to 200kg per layer, 400kg in total) is the better choice.

settings.question: Do I need tools to assemble?
settings.answer: Our steel and MDF shelving racks use a no-screw design - steel racks click in and MDF racks plug together. Workbenches use a simple bolt-together design. Our Assembly Instructions page has guides for each range.

settings.question: Will it fit in my car?
settings.answer: Everything is flat-packed in boxes. Our How To Collect In Your Vehicle page lists boxed dimensions for each size so you can check before you collect, and delivery is also available.
